title: How a C# program works — quick overview
rememberThis: C# compiles to IL for the CLR; TypeScript erases to JavaScript.
Language version follows TFM; .NET 10 is C# 14. Avoid LangVersion=latest.
One entry point: Main or a single top-level-statements file.
File-based apps (`dotnet run file.cs`) are C# 14 / .NET 10, configured with #: directives.
bullets: CTS is the shared type model; CLR is the host — not Node/V8.
using shortens names; packages still come from NuGet/project references.
Implicit usings are generated global usings.
